title: Direction for Mediation by District Commission

content.scenario: The District Commission, after admitting Rahul's complaint, assessed that there were elements of a settlement acceptable to both parties. The Commission directed Rahul and the retailer to give written consent for mediation within five days.
content.outcome: Rahul and the retailer gave their written consent for mediation, and the District Commission referred the matter to a mediator. The mediator then carried out the mediation procedure to resolve the consumer dispute.
